project.description: The {@link ReliabilityMl.Project} for which this spec must be instantiated.

assetFilter.description:
Specify the filter corresponding to {@link ReliabilityAsset}s for which the provided pipelines in
{@link #modelCreationSpecs} should be trained.

datasetPreparationRunFilter.description:
Optionally, instead specify filter corresponding to the dataset preparation runs for which the provided
pipelines in {@link #modelCreationSpecs} should be trained.
If specified along with {@link #modelCreationSpecs}, it will override the given {@link #assetFilter}.
If specified along with {@link #models}, this field will be ignored.

modelCreationSpecs.description:
Specify all the {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline}s that should be trained for the provided
{@link #assetFilter}/{@link #datasetPreparationRunFilter}.

pipelineFilter.description:
Directly specify the {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline}s to create and train {@ReliabilityMlModel}s for using a filter,
instead of providing {@link #modelCreationSpecs}.
NOTE: If both modelCreationSpecs and pipelineFilter are provided, then {@ReliabilityMlModel}s will be created and trained for
both of them.

modelNamePrefix.description:
Optionally, specify a {@ReliabilityMlModel#name model name} prefix to be used for the trained models. This prefix is only used for models
created from the pipelines matching the #pipelineFilter. If not specified, the model name is auto-generated.

models.description:
Specify a list of {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s, each of which can either be trained or untrained.

If a {@link ReliabilityMlModel} is trained, it will simply be deployed as a `CANDIDATE` model. See {@link #deploymentAssetFilter}
if you want to control which {@link ReliabilityAsset}s each model should be deployed against.

If an untrained {@link ReliabilityMlModel} is provided, the model must have it's `datasetPreparationRun` field populated.

If {@link #trainOnAllAssetsInFilter} is set to False, the model will be trained on the {@link ReliabilityAsset} corresponding
to `model.datasetPreparationRun.parent`, and the `assetFilter` is ignored.

If {@link #trainOnAllAssetsInFilter} is set to True and an {@link #assetFilter} is provided, it will be trained on the
given {@link #assetFilter}.

NOTE: In both cases, the provided {@link #datasetPreparationRunFilter} will be ignored.

trainOnAllAssetsInFilter.description:
Specify whether to train one model for all assets in the {@link #assetFilter}/{@link #datasetPreparationRunFilter}
(`true`), or for each of those assets (`false`).

deploymentAssetFilter.description:
Specify the filter corresponding to {@link ReliabilityAsset}s for which the trained models
should be deployed on as `CANDIDATE`.
If not specified, the models will be deployed for the {@link ReliabilityAsset}s corresponding to the
`model.trainInput.subjectFilter`.

pipelineTemplate.description:
{@link ModelTemplate} that was used for creating the pipelines matching the #pipelineFilter.
NOTE: This should only be used when #modelCreationSpecs are not provided, and will only be used for setting
the {@link ReliabilityMlModel#template} field for the created models. If #modelCreationSpecs are provided, the template should be set in
the corresponding {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJob.ModelCreationSpec}.

title:
Spec for customizing how {@link ReliabilityMl.Pipeline}s should be trained by the
{@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.TrainingJob}
